title: Life, damage and Triggers
goal: Know what happens when your Leader gets hit, and how the game ends.

steps.html: When your Leader takes damage, move your top Life card into your hand. Getting hit hurts, but it also gives you a card. Some players save their Counters early and let a few hits through.
Some cards have Trigger. If that card is the Life card you take, you can show it and use its Trigger effect for free instead of putting it in your hand.

callouts.label: [Trigger] Play this card: if this flips from your Life, it comes into play for free.

steps.html:
Two attack keywords change damage:

  • Double Attack: deals 2 damage instead of 1.
  • Banish: the Life card goes to the trash. No card in hand, no Trigger.

How a game ends: a Leader with 0 Life takes damage, or a player has 0 cards left in their deck.

quiz.q: Your Leader takes 1 damage. Where does your top Life card go?
quiz.why: Life cards go to your hand, unless you use a Trigger or it was Banished.

quiz.q: Your Life card has [Trigger]. What can you do?
choices: Use its Trigger effect instead of adding it to your hand
Play it as a second Leader
quiz.why: A Trigger is a free effect you may use, or you can just add the card to your hand.

quiz.q: Which of these makes you lose?
quiz.why: If your deck reaches 0 cards, you lose.
